question: Two triangles Δ ABC and Δ DEF are similar. If AB = 6 cm, BC = 8 cm and DE = 9 cm, find EF.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **similar triangles** ΔABC and ΔDEF, the **ratio of corresponding sides** is equal.

Side Ratio: AB ÷ DE = BC ÷ EF

Substitute values: 6 ÷ 9 = 8 ÷ EF

2 ÷ 3 = 8 ÷ EF

EF = (8 × 3) ÷ 2 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AB = 6 cm, BC = 8 cm, DE = 9 cm, and ΔABC ∼ ΔDEF.

**Formula Used:** Ratio of corresponding sides of similar triangles: AB/DE = BC/EF = AC/DF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a10905055c267658a7b164e60862a217840e8b506e325a8026168ab862edcfa.png] 

Since ΔABC ∼ ΔDEF, we use the property of proportionality:

⇒ AB ÷ DE = BC ÷ EF

⇒ 6 ÷ 9 = 8 ÷ EF

⇒ 2 ÷ 3 = 8 ÷ EF

⇒ 2 × EF = 8 × 3

⇒ 2 × EF = 24

⇒ EF = 24 ÷ 2

⇒ EF = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

AA (Angle-Angle) Similarity

If two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar.

Area Ratio Property

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(Δ1)/Area(Δ2) = (Side1/Side2)².

Corresponding Parts

In similar triangles, corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are in the same ratio (proportional).</p
